text:
mira: quick design drop for the scorecard density toggle + approval microflow. mock: https://img.redwood.dev/mock/scorecard-density-approve.png

jon: tl;dr?

mira: two density modes (compact / comfortable). compact hides comment previews and shows a tiny regression badge; comfortable shows one-line comment and larger avatars. approval bar becomes sticky with primary right-aligned.

kevin: compact should still expose keyboard affordances. proposal: row Enter expands details; Space toggles selection; `A` approves selection. ensure `aria-expanded` and `aria-live` announce expansion.

sam: accessibility: contrast on primary CTA fails. aria_bot suggests darker blue. also focus ring must be 3px with clear offset.

aria_bot: accessibility-check: suggested CTA #0E50C9 meets 4.6:1. recommend `role=status` for approval toast and `role=region` for details.

jon: microcopy: sticky CTA label switches between "Approve run" and "Approve selected (n)". show tooltip when disabled: "Select tests to approve".

mira: open question: show sticky bar always or only when selection exists? leaning always visible but disabled to keep layout stable.

kevin: agree. action items: (mira) update colors and upload new PNG (2201234575), (sam) add aria-live + toast pattern, (jon) docs for keyboard shortcuts.

mira: thanks! will follow up with a small HTML prototype for screenreader testing.
